Best Wrench Sets

A combination wrench is two tools in one: an open end that slides onto a fitting, and a closed box end that surrounds the nut. Use the wrong end on a stuck bolt and you round it. From a $30 stubby metric set to a $200 SAE and metric 34-piece, here is what actually matters when you buy.
